name: MeetMinutes
description_en:
MeetMinutes is a product in the Note taking category. Its directory profile covers Recurring Tasks, Share Link, File Sharing, Real-time Collaboration, Task Tracking, Templates, Meetings.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Freelancers Individuals. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Starts at $1.0. Offers Free-forever and Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: make files available to authorized participants; reuse predefined layouts or workflow structures. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
